summary: Diabetes tech firms Senseonics and Beta Bionics launched an integration this week of their glucose sensors and insulin pumps. Senseonics makes a continuous glucose monitor that can be implanted for up to a year, called Eversense 365. That device is now compatible with Beta Bionics’ iLet Bionic Pancreas automated insulin delivery system. The integration follows a partnership that the two companies struck in September. In the future, they plan to also pair Senseonics’ one-year CGM with Beta Bionics’ new tubeless patch pump, called Mint.
